question_cn: 「开放线」和「半开放线」有何区别？
question_en: What is the difference between an open file and a half-open file?

options.text_cn: 开放线指没有任何兵的纵线；半开放线指只有己方一个兵的纵线
options.text_en: An open file has no pawns; a half-open file has only one friendly pawn.

options.text_cn: 开放线指没有任何兵的纵线；半开放线指只有对方兵、己方无兵的纵线
options.text_en: An open file has no pawns; a half-open file has an enemy pawn but no friendly pawn.

options.text_cn: 开放线只对车有用；半开放线对象更有用
options.text_en: Open files are useful only to rooks; half-open files are more useful to bishops.

options.text_cn: 两者相同，都指没有己方兵的纵线
options.text_en: They are the same: both mean a file with no friendly pawn.

explanation_cn: 开放线（Open File）：整条纵线上双方都没有兵，车可以自由穿行全线。半开放线（Semi-open File）：己方没有兵、但对方有兵，车可以沿此线向前施压、攻击对方的兵。西西里防御中黑方走c5后，c线上黑方无兵，c线就成为黑方的半开放线，Rc8顺势占领施压。
explanation_en: An open file has no pawns from either side, allowing a rook to travel freely along it. A half-open file has no friendly pawn but still contains an enemy pawn, which the rook can pressure. In the Sicilian, after ...c5, Black may use the c-file as a half-open file and place a rook on c8.
